claim.claim-text: 1. A digital signal processing device (750) comprising:
a first channel configured to process a first signal originating from a subject to obtain a first intermediate frequency (IF) signal with a first bit-width; and a second channel configured to:

divide a second signal originating from the subject to obtain a third signal with a third bit-width and a fourth signal with a fourth bit-width; and combine the third signal with the fourth signal to obtain a second IF signal with the first bit-width.
2. The device (750) of claim 1, wherein the first signal originates from hydrogen nuclei in the subject by a magnetic resonance imaging system.
3. The device (750) of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the second signal originates from non-hydrogen nuclei in the subject by the magnetic resonance imaging system.
4. The device (750) of any one of claims 1-3, further comprising a band pass decimation filter configured to process the first signal to obtain the first IF signal.
5. The device (750) of any one of claims 1-4, wherein in-phase/quadrature (I/Q) demodulation is employed to divide the second signal into the third signal and the fourth signal.
6. The device (750) of claim 5, further comprising a low pass decimation filter configured to perform the I/Q demodulation.

7. The device (750) of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the first bit-width is extended from a fifth bit-width by adding one or more zeros after the least significant bit (LSB) of the first IF signal, or adding one or more signs before the most significant bit (MSB) of the first IF signal.
8. The device (750) of any one of claims 1-7, wherein each of the third bit-width and the fourth bit-width equals to a half of the first bit-width.

9. The device (750) of any one of claims 1-8, wherein to divide the second signal originating from the subject to obtain the third signal with the third bit-width and the fourth signal with the fourth bit-width, the second channel is configured to:

truncate a bit-width of the third signal into the third bit-width by a first truncation element (1613); and truncate a bit-width of the fourth signal into the fourth bit-width by a second truncation element (1614).

10. The device (750) of claim 9, wherein to truncate a bit-width of the third signal into the third bit-width, the first truncation element (1613) is configured to: remove the MSB of the bit-width of the third signal.

11. The device (750) of claim 9, wherein to truncate a bit-width of the fourth signal into the fourth bit-width, the second truncation element (1614) is configured to: remove the MSB of the bit-width of the fourth signal.

12. The device (750) of any one of claims 5-11, wherein the in-phase/quadrature (I/Q) demodulation is performed on the second signal based on a first clock signal, and the first clock signal is obtained from an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) (740; 1410) connected to the digital signal processing device (750).
13. The device (750) of claim 7, wherein the fifth bit-width is an actual available bit-width of the first IF signal.
14. A method implemented on a digital signal processing device (750) which includes a signal processing channel (1010), a register (1020), and a load interface (1030), the method comprising:

dividing, via a second channel selected by the signal processing channel (1010), the second signal to obtain a third signal with a third bit-width and a fourth signal with a fourth bit-width; and combining, via the second channel selected by the signal processing channel (1010), the third signal with the fourth signal to obtain a second IF signal with the first bit-width.
15. The method of claim 14, further comprising:
generating k-space data based on the first IF signal or the second IF signal; and generating an image based on the k-space data.
